metaDescription: Seven Tiffany style stained glass table lamps compared on shade size, glass, base material, switch and bulb, from 8 inch accent lamps to a 24 inch triple light.
expertTake: The Pterying 16 by 24 inch triple light lamp is the best overall pick, because a genuine hand cut stained glass shade, a separate night light and a size that works on a sideboard or a large end table give it the most presence and use. The LXHCYOU mission lamp is the value pick for a standard bedside, and the Rynxphera 8 inch is the one for a small shelf or desk. Skip a stained glass lamp if you need bright reading light, since colored glass cuts output sharply.
introParagraphs: A stained glass table lamp is built from small pieces of colored glass joined into a shade, and the result throws patterned, jewel toned light across a room. The style is decorative first and functional second, which is exactly why it suits a side table, a hallway or a bedside.

Nearly every lamp in this category is a style homage, not an original from a historic workshop, and the real differences are in the glass, the joinery, the base and the bulb. We evaluated seven options on shade size, glass construction, base weight and the practical light they give.

products.name: Pterying 16 x 24 in Tiffany Style Stained Glass Table Lamp, Triple Light, Hand Crafted

specList.label: Lights

specList.label: Night light

products.description:
A 16 inch wide and 24 inch tall lamp with a shade hand crafted from genuine stained glass and a triple light design. The lower base light works independently as a night light through a vintage style bulb, so you can run the base glow alone for a low ambient light and switch the shade lights on for the full effect.

At 24 inches high with a 16 inch shade, it is the largest lamp in the lineup and carries real presence on a sideboard or a large end table. A larger shade also means a larger glow area, though colored glass still limits brightness and the lamp should be treated as ambient light, not task light. Compared with the 12 inch lamps here, the 16 inch shade gives more spread and more glass pattern.

Place it on a stable surface, since the shade and base are tall and heavy. Use LED bulbs to limit heat, keep the glass away from direct sun and dust it gently with a soft brush.

products.name: Pterying 12 x 19 in Stained Glass Rose Table Lamp, Hand Cut Glass, 2700K LED Bulb

specList.label: Bulb
specList.value: 2700K warm white LED, standard base included

products.description:
A 12 by 19 inch lamp with a hand cut stained glass shade in a rose pattern and a 2700K warm white LED bulb with a standard base in the box. The included bulb is a small but useful detail: many lamps ship without one, and 2700K is the right warm colour to show off stained glass without washing it out.

A 12 inch shade and 19 inch height is the standard size for this style, suited to a nightstand, a side table or a hallway console. The rose pattern is traditional and romantic, which suits cottage and vintage rooms better than modern ones. Compared with the 16 inch Pterying, it is smaller and cheaper, and it has no night light base.

Place it where the light can scatter on a wall or a table, and use a dimmable LED if you want to adjust the mood. Wipe the glass with a dry microfibre cloth.

products.name: LXHCYOU Mission Style Stained Glass Table Lamp, 12 x 19 in, Zipper Switch
products.description:
A mission style stained glass lamp at 12 by 19 inches with an intricate shade pattern and a zipper switch on the cord. The mission style uses geometric panels and straight lines rather than florals, which makes it easier to place in a craftsman, arts and crafts or transitional room.

A zipper switch is a small slide switch on the cord, which is convenient but less satisfying than a base switch, and the cord is where it wears. The listing positions the lamp as a desk, bedside or decorative accent, which suits a versatile size. Compared with the Pterying rose lamp, the mission pattern is more architectural and less romantic.

Check the cord and the switch for strain relief, keep the bulb low heat and place the lamp on a stable surface. Dust the glass with a soft cloth.

products.name: LXHCYOU Blue Baroque Stained Glass Table Lamp, 12 in Shade, 79 in Cord, Metal Leaf Base
products.description:
A 12 inch blue baroque shade on a durable metal base decorated with leaf motifs, with a 79 inch cord that gives flexible placement. The metal base is a notable build point: metal is heavier and more stable than a resin base, so the lamp is less likely to tip with the shade's top heavy weight.

The 79 inch cord is long enough to reach an outlet from a console or a side table without an extension, which is a practical feature on a lamp that you place for looks. The blue baroque palette is a bold colour choice, and it suits a room with neutral walls where the lamp is the accent. Compared with the mission lamp, it is more ornate and has a metal rather than a simple base.

Check that the base sits flat, route the cord neatly and use a warm LED bulb. The metal base may need a felt pad on a polished table.

products.name: LUSTIX Tiffany Table Lamp, 19 in, Ivory Pearl Style, 12 x 12 x 19 in
products.description:
A 12 by 12 by 19 inch lamp with a shade made from small coloured glass fragments welded together in an ivory and pearl palette. The listing explains the construction: the shade is cut into small pieces and joined, which is the traditional method for this style and the source of its pattern.

An ivory and pearl palette is softer and more neutral than a blue or red shade, and it throws a warm, pale glow that suits bedrooms and cream rooms. The tradeoff is that pale glass lets more light through than dark glass, so it is the best choice here for brighter output. Compared with the blue baroque, it is calmer and more adaptable.

Place it where the light can reach the wall, use a warm LED bulb and handle the shade gently when moving it. Dust with a soft brush.

products.name: wecrejoni Tiffany Style Pink Tulip Small Lamp, 8 x 14 in Shade, Resin Base
products.description:
A small pink tulip lamp with an 8 inch wide by 14 inch high shade and a resin base that the listing calls sturdy and durable. The size suits a small nightstand, a shelf or a desk where a 12 inch lamp would crowd the space.

A resin base is lighter than metal and moulds fine detail cheaply, but it is less stable and can crack if knocked. The shade is smaller, so the light is more of a glow than a spread, and the pink tulip pattern is distinctly feminine and decorative. Compared with the Rynxphera 8 inch, it is a similar scale in a different pattern.

Place it in a spot where it will not be bumped, and use a low heat LED bulb. Wipe the glass gently with a dry cloth.

products.name: Rynxphera Small Mission Style Stained Glass Lamp, 8 in Shade, Olive Antique, Plastic Base
products.description:
A small mission style lamp with an 8 inch stained glass shade in an olive antique palette and a finished plastic base. The listing states that the shade is handcrafted from real stained glass, which is the key quality point: the glass is the lamp, and the base is secondary.

A plastic base is the weakest part, since it is light and a top heavy glass shade can tip it, so the lamp should sit on a flat surface away from foot traffic. Olive antique is a muted, earthy palette that suits craftsman and cottage rooms. Compared with the wecrejoni, it shares the 8 inch scale but has a geometric mission pattern.

Use a low heat LED bulb, keep the cord out of walkways and check the base for stability. Dust the glass with a soft cloth.

buyingCriteria.explanation: A 12 inch shade on a 19 inch lamp is the standard size for a nightstand or side table, an 8 inch shade suits a shelf or desk, and a 16 inch shade suits a sideboard or a large end table. The lamp should be about the width of a third of the table. Measure the surface before choosing.

Real stained glass is cut, wrapped and joined, and it has weight and slight variation. Cheaper lamps use moulded plastic or printed acrylic that imitates the look. The Pterying listings say hand cut glass and the Rynxphera says real stained glass. Ask for the construction method and be wary of vague wording.

A metal base is heavier and more stable than resin or plastic, and a stained glass shade is top heavy. The LXHCYOU baroque has a metal base, while the small lamps use resin or plastic. Place lighter lamps on stable surfaces away from edges and foot traffic.

Use a low heat LED bulb in a warm 2700K colour to protect the glass joins and to show the colours. The Pterying rose includes a 2700K LED. Avoid high wattage incandescent bulbs, since heat can stress the soldered joints and the cord.

Coloured glass absorbs most of the light, so these lamps make ambient glow, not task light. Pale shades, like the ivory pearl, let through more than dark blue or olive. If you need reading light, add a second lamp.

Zipper switches on the cord are convenient but wear out, base switches are more durable, and a long cord, like 79 inches, helps placement. Check for strain relief and a polarised plug. Keep the cord out of walkways.

howWeEvaluated.title: Glass and craft
howWeEvaluated.description: We read each listing for hand cut, hand crafted or real stained glass claims. The Pterying and Rynxphera listings were weighed above vague decorative claims. We noted that all of these are style homages.

howWeEvaluated.title: Base and stability
howWeEvaluated.description: We compared metal, resin and plastic bases for tip resistance with a top heavy shade. The metal base scored highest. We noted placement advice for light bases.

howWeEvaluated.title: Size and fit
howWeEvaluated.description: We compared shade sizes from 8 to 16 inches against typical nightstands, shelves and sideboards. Standard 12 by 19 inch lamps scored for flexibility. We noted scale mismatches.

howWeEvaluated.title: Light and bulb
howWeEvaluated.description: We looked at bulb notes, colour temperature and brightness expectations. The included 2700K LED scored well. We noted that coloured glass limits task light.

howWeEvaluated.title: Owner feedback patterns
howWeEvaluated.description: We researched recurring owner themes on stained glass lamps, such as shipping breakage, loose joins and wobbly bases. These patterns shaped the ownership notes. We did not run physical tests, and we do not use star ratings.

cards.label: Metal (LXHCYOU baroque)
cards.text: Heavier, stable and less likely to tip. Can scratch polished surfaces.

cards.label: Resin or plastic (wecrejoni, Rynxphera)
cards.text: Light and easy to move. Less stable and can crack if knocked.

howToChoose.note: Choose metal for busy spots and resin or plastic for low risk shelves.

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: A 12 inch shade or smaller, a pale glass palette and a base switch. Avoid heavy dark shades that cut the light.

cards.label: In this comparison
cards.text: The LUSTIX and the Pterying rose fit bedrooms best. The 16 inch Pterying suits a larger bedroom dresser.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: The lamp is a display piece and you want hand cut glass and a larger size. A better shade is the whole point.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: The lamp is a small accent. A resin or plastic lamp covers it.
